pakete-pruefen.hilfe:
pakete-pruefen – check package folders with the installer of this Ablago version

Usage:  pakete-pruefen [options] <folder> [<folder> …]

Each folder is a package as in dms-registry (manifest.yaml at the top); a folder containing package
folders (e.g. pakete/) stands for all of them. Ablago installs the packages in dependency order into an
empty library in memory – no database server, no network. If the same id appears in several versions,
it installs the oldest and then updates to the newer ones (update old → new).

Options
  --ablago <version>   check as this Ablago version (dms in the manifest)
  --ohne-beispiele     do not install the examples
  --json               result as JSON
  --ergebnis <file>    also write the result as JSON to this file
  --sprache en         output in English
  --hilfe              this overview

Exit code: 0 all OK, 1 at least one package with errors, 2 wrong usage.
Manual: https://help.ablago.app/entwickler/aktuell/en/pakete/#pakete-mit-ablago-pruefen
